# Product Genome Studio

> A hands-on simulator to design a product by picking real UX patterns at every funnel stage, with tradeoffs, conflicts, and a goal-guided assist.

Product Genome Studio lets you compose a product genome across acquisition, onboarding, core loop, retention, and monetization stages. Each choice comes from a real pattern used by a shipping company, with tradeoffs and a live phone preview.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Explore industries and start composing a product.
- [Add industry](/add): Suggest or generate a new industry to simulate.

## Optional

- [Studio example - Travel](/studio/travel): Interactive studio for the travel industry.
